tooltip.pocketdimensions.pocket_anchor.0: A sealed room, bigger on the inside.
tooltip.pocketdimensions.pocket_anchor.m: Crouch + jump inside to leave again.
Crouch + right-click a block to set it
down; crouch + right-click it to take
it, even while others are inside.
Anyone may enter. Break it with a
diamond pickaxe and the room, with
all it holds, is lost forever.

tooltip.pocketdimensions.world_anchor.mo: Only the realm's owner and those on
its access list may pass, unless a
World Breacher has torn it open.
Linked, nothing can mine it; only an
Anchor Breaker can unmake it. Empty,
a diamond pickaxe lifts it in moments.

it must hold nothing unbreakable, so
a siege can always reach it.
